summary: Golf and bar car park backing onto trees; nearest home 38 m away.
reasons: East edge backs onto dense trees
Sealed car park with marked bays

best_section.where: Eastern bays of the car park beside the trees, off Carawa Street

drivers.seclusion: Backs onto trees and golf grounds; houses 38 m or more away over the road.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed entrance from the road to the north; bays with room for a van.
drivers.traffic: Busy road to the north, but the bays sit well back from it.
drivers.convention: Unsigned, free car park shared by golf, mini-golf and bar users; many cars parked.

flags: Noise from the Hundred Acre Bar and golf venue
Mapped gates nearby are not on the only access
Max grade 7.6% on the entry ramp, flat in the bays
sun_shade: Trees shade the east side in the morning; open to the afternoon sun from the west.
